name: Candolim Beach & Water Sports
description: Scenic and relatively relaxed sandy beach famous for parasailing jet skis and tranquil shoreline walks.
notes: Outdoor water sports stop operating during rain or high wind.

name: Fort Aguada & Lighthouse
description: 17th-century Portuguese fortress and lighthouse overlooking the confluence of the Mandovi River and Arabian Sea.
notes: Open ramparts with steep stone steps slippery during rain.

name: Houses of Goa Museum
description: Fascinating multi-level ship-shaped architectural museum celebrating traditional Goan-Portuguese residential design.
notes: Completely indoor and ideal rainy day cultural excursion.

name: Mario Miranda Gallery & Art Cafe
description: Vibrant gallery displaying iconic illustrations caricatures Goan cultural prints and handcrafted souvenirs.
approx_distance_area: In central Candolim on Fort Aguada Road
notes: Air-conditioned indoor space with boutique coffee counter.

name: Reis Magos Fort & Cultural Centre
description: Restored 1551 fortress boasting covered historical galleries Mario Miranda art exhibits and indoor naval displays.
notes: Has extensive indoor exhibition halls protected from monsoon showers.

name: Calamari Bathe & Binge
description: Popular beachfront restaurant serving Goan seafood butter garlic prawns cocktails and chilled acoustic vibes.
notes: Open-air shack seating on the sand canopy available for light drizzle.

name: Fisherman's Wharf
description: Celebrated riverside dining destination with covered dining halls serving authentic Goan fish curry and recheado crab.
notes: Spacious sheltered indoor and river-facing seating with live music.

name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter Indoor Walk & Cafes
description: Historic precinct with vibrant Portuguese houses indoor heritage art spaces and cozy bakeries.
notes: Sheltered cafe-hopping gallery visits and indoor heritage boutique tours.

name: SinQ Night Club & Showbar Exchange
description: High-energy nightlife hub featuring upbeat DJ sets indoor club lounge poolside cabanas and signature cocktails.
notes: Features fully air-conditioned indoor club room that is completely rainproof.

name: Titlie Culinary Bar
description: Cliffside culinary bar boasting open-air sunset views over Little Vagator innovative global sharing plates and craft cocktails.
notes: Open terrace cliff seating best visited on clear evenings.

name: Gunpowder
description: Renowned South Indian coastal haven set in a vintage Portuguese villa courtyard serving Pandi curry and appams.
notes: Covered heritage veranda dining sheltered from precipitation.

name: Anjuna Flea Market & Curlies
description: Legendary bohemian beachfront hotspot famous for sunset chillout sessions and psychedelic trance rhythms.
notes: Predominantly outdoor beach setup vulnerable to monsoons.

name: Baga Beach Boardwalk & Tito's Lane
description: The bustling party epicenter of North Goa packed with lively shacks music lounges and neon-lit lanes.

name: Savoi Spice Plantation Experience
description: Organic 200-year-old spice plantation offering covered pavilion botanical tours and traditional buffet lunch.
notes: Covered gazebos and dining pavilions make this a lush rainy-day sensory escape.

name: Palolem Beach Crescent & Kayaking
description: Postcard-perfect golden crescent bay in South Goa framed by swaying coconut groves and calm blue waters.
approx_distance_area: 90 mins drive from Candolim (South Goa Day Trip)
notes: Ideal day trip when weather is dry and sunny.
